notes.text: Gist not Pulling from github at first launch after connecting with github
Better error prompts when something doesn't work as intended
Drag-N-Dropping of Project Cards in List View.
Moved Git Worktrees from Experimental to Stable, with improved UI and UX
Gave each of your Projects a unique ID (.github.json file) that will be used to track your project's time so changing the directory location now won't reset your time tracked

Feature Issue #198 - Assign folders to categories in Manage Categories: any project found inside an assigned folder is automatically filed under that category, and projects already there are sorted right away
